note: P4387 (Pro 31:10) — an excellent wife who can find? She is far more precious than jewels.

dims.v: excellence — the capable wife, worth far more than jewels
the excellence/valour of the capable wife whom the acrostic celebrates — the woman of strength and worth ('eshet chayil') who is far more precious than jewels, the sum of the virtues the poem unfolds
the strong, capable excellence that surpasses all price

chayil (strength/valour/excellence) — 'an EXCELLENT wife who can find? She is far more precious than jewels' (31:10); 'eshet chayil' — a woman of valour, whose worth the whole acrostic (31:10-31) unfolds. Her excellence is a strength and capability beyond price (cf 12:4; Ruth 3:11).
